summary.title: Who We Are
phrases: We put technology and innovation at the service of hygiene and the environment, with a clear goal: to provide effective, sustainable, and personalized solutions.

AFRICA CLEAN is a startup specialized in the CleanTech sector: manufacturing eco-friendly bins from recycled materials, waste management, event cleaning, and creating green spaces and vegetable gardens.
Each service is designed to combine efficiency, quality, and respect for the environment.

history.description: A journey of innovation and commitment to the environment

stats.title: Beginnings (2018)
stats.subtitle: Founded as GROUPE LUMIERE JEUNESSE
stats.description:
AFRICA CLEAN was founded in 2018 under the name GROUPE LUMIERE JEUNESSE. Initially, the company provided professional cleaning and maintenance services for premises as well as the design, creation, and maintenance of green spaces and vegetable gardens.

Later, the company expanded its activities to include waste management and event cleaning, moving and transporting goods, as well as manufacturing eco-friendly and customized bins.

stats.title: Evolution (2023)
stats.subtitle: Renamed AFRICA CLEAN
stats.description: In 2023, the company changed its name to AFRICA CLEAN to better reflect its mission of providing high-quality cleaning and maintenance services to clients, with a broader vision across Africa.
